Primary request:
Create exactly one small centered twelve-point mathematical star lattice for Vivhite. It is a compact secondary moving mechanism inside the existing larger ring, not a finished icon.

One centered compact lattice only, outer diameter about 30 percent and clear circular opening about 18 percent of the square. Keep at least 34 percent completely empty margin on every side. Use twelvefold rotational balance so every angle remains stable while spinning. Keep all color and luminosity close to the lattice. No filled core, rear disc, broad annulus, large outer frame, long spear-like points, crown, butterfly, particles or detached sparks.

Style and palette:
Polished hand-painted fantasy card-game UI, crisp after later resizing to 32 and 64 pixels. Dominant violet and cool blue, restrained white accents and tiny antique-gold beads. Fine but not hairline-thin, moderate opacity, bounded internal light, lower visual mass than the slow ring.

Constraints:
Exactly one coherent centered lattice layer. No text, letters, numerals, symbols resembling text, character, face, body, mouth element, weapon, blood, liquid, scenery, panel, sprite sheet, duplicate, watermark, border touching the square, external aura, bloom, haze, mist, rays or light field.
